spans.s: गुलुच्छ m. A bunch, a cluster.
गुलुच्छ m. A bunch, a cluster.
गुल्फ m. the ankle, आगुल्फकीर्णापणमार्गपुष्पम् K.S.vii.25.

गुल्म m.n. 1. A clump of trees, a thicket, a bush, M.i.48, vii.192; 2. a troop of soldiers, a division of an army, consisting of 45 foot, 27 horse, 90 chariots and as many elephants; 3. a fort; 4. the spleen; 5. a chronic enlargement of the spleen (in medicine); 6. a police station; 7. a wharf of stairs.
गुल्मिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Growing as clump or cluster; 2. having the spleen affected by disease.
